result.title: CalibTrack: Exploring Learned Heteroscedastic Covariance for Robust Multi-Camera Pedestrian Tracking
result.summary: Analytical multi-view multi-object tracking (MV-MOT) systems rely on measurement covariance estimates to guide association, fusion, and state estimation. These covariance estimates are typically heuristic, requiring hand-tuning to the specific deployment scenario. We investigate how learned heteroscedastic measurement covariance affects calibration and robustness in analytical multi-camera tracking. To support this analysis, we introduce CalibTrack, a detector-side predictor that replaces uniform measurement covariance with per-detection covariance. We evaluate CalibTrack on the WildTrack and MultiviewX pedestrian tracking datasets with multiple analytical tracker cores, including an identity-informed GM-PHD, JIPDA, and pruned delta-GLMB filter. We additionally evaluate robustness by simulating adverse weather conditions with stable diffusion, Gaussian noise, camera browning, and camera dropout. CalibTrack improves average adverse tracking performance over confidence-scaled covariance, while producing better calibrated predictions, indicating the value of heteroscedastic covariance within analytical tracking. Comparisons with stronger heuristic covariance methods show that the benefits of learned covariance remain bounded by the quality of available observations and the downstream tracker choice. Together, these findings provide a principled exploration of learned covariance estimation and its potential for uncertainty-aware analytical tracking.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究多相机行人跟踪中测量协方差的估计方式，提出检测端的 CalibTrack，为每个检测输出异方差协方差，替代统一协方差，并在 WildTrack、MultiviewX 上配合多种解析跟踪器（GM-PHD、JIPDA、delta-GLMB）检验标定质量与恶劣天气、噪声、掉线等条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其逐检测学习不确定性并考察标定与使用效果的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的可靠性加权与筛选提供可核查的线索；但任务为多相机跟踪，与推理状态生成无直接联系，迁移价值需读原文判断。
